about:
Heartland Electronics & Cable Assembly (HECA) operates from a 42,500-square-foot facility in Toney, Alabama, just north of Huntsville. The company began operations in the Tennessee Valley in 1987 as a small, build-to-order electronics contract manufacturer. No founders are named in public materials.

HECA specializes in printed circuit board assembly using both surface-mount and through-hole technologies, supported by three SMT lines equipped with high-speed placers rated at 15,000 and 11,000 components per hour. The company also provides cable and wire harness assembly, box build and sub-assembly integration, component procurement, in-circuit and functional testing, and metal or plastic enclosure work. Services span quick-turn prototypes through full production runs under turnkey or consignment models.

The customer base includes government and commercial accounts, with the company citing experience in both sectors. AS9100D certification indicates work in aerospace and defense, though specific industry verticals are not detailed in public materials.

HECA emphasizes flexibility, quick-turn prototyping, RoHS/lead-free compliance, and a quality system certified to ISO 9001:2015 and AS9100D. Its stated mission is to meet or exceed contracted requirements with on-time delivery and continuous improvement, aiming to be a preferred outsourcing partner.
